proposal.expected_benefit: This change ensures that the fundamental flaw in the audit anchor is addressed immediately, preventing potential exploitation of the failed integrity verification mechanism.
proposal.problem: The audit anchor failure is not being treated as a critical failure that should immediately block the transaction, despite the explicit requirement for audit integrity.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement an immediate validation check for the audit anchor status before any financial execution. If the audit anchor is failed, the transaction must be blocked without further processing, regardless of other signals or mitigations.
proposal.title: Ensure Immediate Audit Anchor Validation
verification_tests: Test case: Transaction with failed audit anchor should be blocked immediately.
Test case: Audit anchor validation should occur before any financial execution.
